admission.justification: Interposed-cut, burst and lockless-read cases pin the lock contract; without the record a stuck lock could hang a call.

applicability: Workspace-river lock holders and EventStore appends.
conditions: Historical blocking callers keep timeout None; the tool-event writer bounds its wait.
exclusions: Lifecycle logs, which never take the lock.

evidence: case test_every_append_lands_at_or_under_the_ceiling in mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py (admission under the river lock); pytest mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 -q -> 16 passed; notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L114-worker-4b5eb1b1-ea79-4dac-b8dd-ef796451e0b6.md

statement: Workspace-river lock with optional bounded wait; existing blocking behavior unchanged.
